title: Junior Putter Reshaft
body_html:
~section 2~

As your junior golfer grows, their putter can grow with them. Our reshaft service makes it easy to update the length of your Bettinardi Junior Series putter, helping ensure the proper fit through every stage of their game. 

Choose your shaft length and grip and send your putter in to us. One of our professional club builders will install your new shaft and grip and get your putter shipped right back to you. 

This service is available exclusively for Junior Series putters. We will not re-shaft putters made by other manufacturers.  

What’s the process? 

  1. On this page, select a length, then select “Add to Cart.” (Do not check out yet!) 

  1. From our grips page, choose a grip that you want installed on your putter and select “Add To Cart” (A grip MUST be purchased with this order to be processed properly. Bettinardi WILL NOT install a grip not purchased from Bettinardi Golf.) 

  1. Go to your cart and check out. 

  1. You mail your putter along with a printout of your order to our headquarters at: Bettinardi Golf ATTN: Reshaft 7650 Graphics Dr. Tinley Park, IL 60477 

  1. We will reshaft and grip your putter. 

  1. We ship the finished putter to the mailing address on your order. 

*Please note the timeframe of 4-6 weeks (from when we receive your putter) for your reshaft and consider this when entering your mailing address.

Engineered for Performance, Styled by You.
Bring your Bettinardi putter to life with the Bettinardi Workshop. Personalize select models with your choice of paint fills, stampings, grip, and headcover. See your setup come together as you build it, then we’ll finish it in our Tinley Park facility with the same precision and care trusted on Tour. The Workshop is your way to add a personal touch—no frills, just pure performance, tailored to you.

Building upon years of American-made craftsmanship, Robert J. Bettinardi has refined his timeless BB1 putter to further enhance its performance. Made in the U.S.A. from a single block of 303 Stainless Steel, the pocket of the new BB1 is milled slightly closer to the heel, resulting in a more balanced center of gravity. Precision-milled to 350 grams with a crowned topline and refreshed bumpers and shoulders, this putter provides players with the perfect optics at address. Our new Perpetual Flymill face milling offers supreme feel and audio feedback and an easily achieved true roll on the green. Through decades of innovating upon a timeless design, the BB1 is RJB’s modern mastery of a classic blade headshape.

All products are made to order. Please allow 6-8 weeks for your Workshop Putter to ship.

~section 3~

CENTER OF GRAVITY SHIFT 
By reshaping the bumpers and shoulders, the Center of Gravity aligns more naturally at address. This enhanced COG establishes a more unified weight distribution, ensuring contact with the sweet spot to achieve a more crisp roll.

PERPETUAL FLYMILL FACE MILLING 
Redefining precision putting, our Bettinardi’s Perpetual Flymill Face Milling technology is now enhanced by sonic precision. This innovative technology provides a consistent roll, ensuring that your putts start true and on target. Each stroke produces a distinctive tone, providing instant feedback to the player.

BLACK PEARL PVD FINISH 
The deep, luxurious black hue of Black Pearl PVD not only exudes sophistication but also adds an extra layer of confidence upon address. Beyond its striking appearance, the PVD coating is highly resistant to wear, scratches, and corrosion.

303 STAINLESS STEEL 
Each BB Series putter is one-piece milled from 303 Stainless Steel, which is the same blend of material preferred by Bettinardi Tour staffers around the globe. This metal offers a more durable, responsive, and solid-feeling putter for supreme performance.

PREMIUM COMPONENTS 
Each BB Series putter comes paired with a Black PVD Tour Grade shaft, custom electric blue Lamkin Grip, and dual-constructed leather and carbon fiber BB Series magnetic headcover.
